name: Tara Chand InfraLogistic Solutions Limited
summary: Tara Chand InfraLogistic Solutions Limited, founded in 1980 and headquartered in Chandigarh, India, provides logistics services across the country. Its business has three divisions: transportation and handling, equipment leasing, and steel processing and distribution. It owns a large fleet of specialized machinery, including many types of cranes, trailers and piling rigs.
